arguments.message:
Sure! To set up a custom domain for your support portal:
1. In Meridian, go to **Settings → General → Custom domain** and enter the domain you want to use. The page will show the exact DNS records you need.
2. At your DNS provider, add two records:
   - A **CNAME** that points the subdomain you chose (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address.
   - A **TXT** record for domain‑ownership verification.
3. Once the records are added, Meridian will automatically verify the domain. Verification may take up to your DNS provider’s propagation time; you can watch the status (pending or verified) on the custom domain settings page.
That’s all you need to get your custom support portal up and running.
